setup.title: Set up workspace
setup.emptyHint: Create your workspace to start bookkeeping. A name is enough: base currency (CHF) and fiscal year (01.01.) are preset and editable later.
setup.name: Company name
setup.legalFormHint: Preset from the name. Everything else is set in the new workspace's company profile.
setup.newHint: A separate set of books beside your existing ones: name and legal form are enough. You are seated in it as owner; the other workspaces stay untouched.

company.title: Company profile

firstHour.lead: Legal form, VAT and the IBAN for your invoices: enter them once, save once. Base currency CHF and a fiscal year from 01.01. are preset.
firstHour.vatHint: Effective method, accounting on agreement (Soll), quarterly returns is the usual case. TILL creates the tax codes when you save.
firstHour.addressLater: You only need the address once the first QR-bill goes out. The IBAN saves now.
firstHour.addressLead: Name and structured address appear on the QR-bill. Without a name, the company name is used.

company.ibanHint: Either kind works. A QR-IBAN (QR-IID 30000 to 31999) gives your invoices a QRR reference, an ordinary IBAN gives them a SCOR reference.

locked.note: Locked: this workspace already has posted entries. Base currency and fiscal-year start are fixed from here on, because the existing entries build on them.

err.invalidIban: That is not a valid IBAN. Please check the number: a QR-IBAN and an ordinary IBAN are both fine here.
err.illegalCharacter: One of these fields contains a character a QR-bill cannot carry, such as a line break. Please keep the name and address on a single line each.
err.needsStructuredAddress: Please provide the full structured address (street, building no., postal code, town, country).
err.invalidCountry: The country is the two-letter code a QR-bill needs, for example CH, LI or DE.
err.fieldTooLong: A field is longer than a QR-bill allows: name and street at most 70 characters, building no. and postcode 16, town 35.
err.ibanNotChLi: A QR-bill needs a Swiss or Liechtenstein account (an IBAN starting with CH or LI). This IBAN is valid, but no QR-bill can be paid into it.
err.needsEmptyLedger: Fiscal year and currency cannot change once entries have been posted.
err.invalidUid: The UID has the form CHE-123.456.789.
err.invalidMwstNo: The VAT number has the form CHE-123.456.789 MWST.
err.invalidLegalForm: TILL does not know this legal form.
err.vatFailed: VAT could not be set up. The other details are saved; set up VAT under VAT.

cannotClear.creditorName: You cannot empty the invoice issuer name here. Enter the company name, or keep the current name.
cannotClear.iban: You cannot remove the IBAN here. Enter a different IBAN, or keep the current one.
cannotClear.uid: You cannot remove the UID here. Enter the correct UID, or keep the current one.
cannotClear.mwstNo: You cannot remove the VAT number here. Enter the correct number, or keep the current one.

err.invalidPaymentTermsDays: The standard payment terms are a whole number of days, from 0 to 365.

terms.label: Standard payment terms (days)
terms.info: Applies to customers and suppliers without payment terms of their own: their invoices fall due this many days after the invoice date. 0 means immediately. Leave empty: due on the invoice date.

ebillConfig.title: eBill
ebillConfig.enrollmentExplainer: Enrolling as a biller happens with a certified network partner, not in TILL. Once enrolled, enter the eBill-Biller-ID the partner issued you.
ebillConfig.invalidBillerPid: The eBill-Biller-ID is 41 followed by 15 digits.
ebillConfig.connectorAbsentDetail: Preparing payloads works offline; transmitting them needs the cloud connector, which is enabled separately.

Setup.title: Setup
Setup.body:
The basics of this workspace: the company profile with name, address, UID, currency and fiscal year, and the management of your workspaces.

On first run the page walks you through creating the workspace; afterwards you edit the profile here. Once postings exist, currency and the fiscal year start are fixed, because the existing entries build on them.

The operational panels such as data backup, trust and diagnostics live under Operations.

workspaceSettings.title: Settings
workspaceSettings.consequence: The change applies to everyone in this workspace from the next action on and is recorded with its reason in the setting's history.

refusal.unknown_setting: This setting is not known to this version of TILL.
refusal.invalid_setting_value: This value is outside what the setting allows.
refusal.reason_required: Please give a reason for the change.
refusal.belegnummer_display_clash: With this change a later voucher number could repeat {display}, which is already taken. Choose another prefix, start or numbering mode.
refusal.belegnummer_prefix_invalid: A prefix is empty or up to 12 characters from {characters}, starts with a letter or digit and does not end in a digit.

workspaceSettings.stale: The stored value {stored} no longer fits this setting, so the default ({value}) applies. Change or reset it.
